name: Automox
description: Let agents read your Automox devices, their missing patches and software, policies and compliance, and, if you allow it, ask a device to scan itself again. For helpdesk triage, compliance checks and troubleshooting.
identity: An Automox API key. It can do whatever its owner's role allows in each organization, so create it as a user whose role only reads devices, packages, policies and reports.

setup.title: Use an account that can only read
setup.body: An Automox API key acts with its owner's role. Create the key as a user, or a service user, whose role has read permissions for devices, packages, policies and reports, and nothing else. Add device manage permission only if agents may ask devices to scan.

link.label: Automox: using API keys and their permissions

click: In the Automox console, sign in as the user agents should act as.
Check that its role grants Devices: Read, Packages: Read, Policies: Read and Reports: Read.

setup.title: Create an API key
setup.body: Create the key while signed in as the user from the step before. A key can be given an expiration date; Automox stops it working then.
click: Go to Settings, then Secrets & Keys.
Under Organization API Keys, select Add.
Enter a name, optionally an expiration date, and select Create.
Select Copy next to the key.

capabilities.label: Read devices and compliance
capabilities.description: List devices and read one: operating system, last seen, missing patches and policy status. Read a device's software and patches, the devices that need attention, policies and how many devices each policy has made compliant.
capabilities.note: Reaches every organization the key's owner can see unless you keep an agent to chosen organizations. Read-only.

capabilities.label: Scan devices
capabilities.description: Ask a device to scan itself now, so its patches and software are up to date before an agent looks again.
capabilities.note: Needs Devices: Manage in the key owner's role. A scan installs nothing and does not restart the device.

limits.label: Organizations
limits.help: Optional: only these Automox organizations, by their numeric id (shown under Automox organizations after connecting). Leave empty for every organization the key can see.

revoke: In Automox, go to Settings, then Secrets & Keys, and delete the key. Agents lose access to Automox at once.

tools.name: automox_list_devices
tools.description: List the devices in an Automox organization, 50 at a time by default. Filter by group, policy, pending patches or whether a policy manages them. Pass page 1, 2 and so on for more; a page shorter than limit is the last.

group_id.description: Only devices in this server group
group_id.name: groupId

policy_id.description: Only devices linked to this policy
policy_id.name: policyId

pending.description: 1: only devices with patches waiting to install; 0: only devices without

managed.description: 1: only devices a policy manages; 0: only unmanaged devices

limit.description: How many devices per page, 1 to 500

tools.name: automox_get_device
tools.description: Read one device: its operating system, network addresses, last scan, missing patches, linked policies and their status, and hardware details.

device_id.description: The device's numeric id or its UUID

include_details.description: 1 to include hardware and system details

tools.name: automox_list_device_software
tools.description: List a device's software and patches: what is installed, what is waiting to install, severity and CVEs, 100 at a time by default. Pass page 1, 2 and so on for more.

tools.name: automox_devices_needing_attention
tools.description: The devices that need attention in an organization, with counts by vulnerability severity.

group_id.description: Only devices in this server group
group_id.name: groupId

offset.description: How many devices to skip, for the next page

tools.name: automox_list_policies
tools.description: List an organization's policies: patch, required software and custom policies, with their schedules and settings. Pass page 1, 2 and so on for more.

tools.name: automox_policy_compliance
tools.description: For each policy in an organization, how many devices are compliant, not compliant and pending.

tools.name: automox_scan_device
tools.description: Ask a device to scan itself now. It reports its software and missing patches again the next time it checks in. Installs nothing.
